interpretation.condition: 0-10 synthetic current-state self-report; neither medical readiness nor military duty fitness
interpretation.reported_intensity: absent from observed features and from current empirical calibration; PMData RPE is target/calibration only
interpretation.observed_activity: duration in minutes plus recorded categorical activity labels; no RPE-derived intensity or session load
interpretation.relative_dose: duration_minutes / 60 / capacity_i times exp(activity_error) times task_demand; capacity_i and task_demand are latent; activity labels are observed but have no fixed intensity multiplier
interpretation.calibration_status: P01/P08/P09 and all PMData/SoccerMon observations are empirical calibration references, not estimates of the military population
interpretation.sensitivity: BASE plus LOW and HIGH for every critical family; one family at a time; no post-result selection
interpretation.distribution_conversion: Manufacturer accuracy bounds, FDA Arms and cross-sectional physiological SD are not Gaussian simulator measurement SD; A10-A12 are independent simulation assumptions
interpretation.parameterization: All coefficients below multiply dimensionless bounded latent units. LOW/BASE/HIGH are stress scenarios, not confidence bounds or physiological estimates.

empirical_P01_P10.sampling: Use frozen calibration.json empirical support and protocol extraction rules without refitting or editing; subject-level bootstrap P01; P02 pooled residual; P03-P06 and P10 empirical; P07-P09 sanity checks only.
empirical_P01_P10.P08: 51 valid average-HR minus previous-day resting-HR values from 64 matched running sessions, not station post-HR
empirical_P01_P10.P09: 13 dated 5-km profiles, running-only capacity dispersion reference; nonrunning capacity dispersion is A02 assumption

P11.status: partly source constrained; simulator site choice assumed
P11.published: Healthy-adult tympanic mean 36.64 C and pooled SD 0.44 C; oral mean 36.57 C and SD 0.42 C; site and age matter.
P11.simulator_choice: Tympanic-equivalent resting temperature proxy, center 36.64 C; this does not imply a tympanic sensor is selected or core-temperature measurement. Subject SD and within-person variation remain P11 assumptions.

P12.status: partly source constrained; population transfer assumed
P12.published: Healthy young volunteers near sea level (43 m): pulse-oximetry mean 98.53%, cross-sectional SD 0.52%; at 725 m: 98.11%, SD 0.8%.
P12.simulator_choice: Near-sea-level healthy-adult reference center 98.53%; altitude and real military population distribution not inferred. Subject SD and within-person variation remain P12 assumptions.

P13.status: no selected complete device; measurement SD assumed
P13.published: MAX30102 component specifications do not establish integrated station pulse-rate error distribution.
P13.simulator_choice: A10 assumed HR error SD; no claim of MAX30102 accuracy.

P14.status: conditional part-number accuracy bound only; measurement SD assumed
P14.published: Medical accuracy of MLX90614Dxx variants is about +/-0.2 C at object temperature 36-38 C under specified ambient/object conditions; not generic MLX90614 or finished forehead-body estimate.
P14.simulator_choice: A11 assumed temperature error SD, independently of manufacturer maximum-error bound.

P15.status: full-system validation bound only; measurement SD assumed
P15.published: FDA 2013 guidance typical Arms at 70-100%: <=3.0 percentage points for transmittance clip/wrap, <=3.5 for reflectance and ear clip; application site and sensor geometry matter.
P15.simulator_choice: A12 assumed SpO2 error SD; Arms is sqrt(mean squared error), not SD, and cannot be substituted as SD or claimed for an unvalidated module.

D01.status: source-guided exclusion of inapplicable heat-index/WBGT claim; numerical proxy assumed
D01.published: NWS Rothfusz heat index is generally applied after an initial estimate around 80 F; WBGT outdoors also requires natural wet-bulb and globe temperature. P10 observed air temperatures are 0.704-22.846 C.
D01.simulator_choice: Station weather proxy z=(T_C-12.369)/5.871; humidity and wind remain observed model features but do not causally enter local heat in v2-minimal. This is an assumption, not WBGT, heat index or physiological heat exposure.

D09.status: protocol-dependent literature sanity check; coefficient assumed
D09.published: Trained cyclists' one-minute drop after maximal test was 22+/-8 or 25+/-12 bpm; different exercise protocol and timepoint.
D09.simulator_choice: D09 mapping remains assumption; no conversion of P08 session average HR to immediate post-HR.

D10.published: Oral versus core temperature diverges during activity and hyperthermia; temperature channel must not be interpreted as core heat-strain diagnosis.
D10.simulator_choice: D10 tympanic-equivalent proxy gain assumed, with no exertional heat-stroke inference.

D11.published: Six-minute walk mean SpO2 decline near sea level 0.38+/-0.65 percentage points, at 725 m 0.37+/-1.12; cannot determine arbitrary task/latent-unit mapping.
D11.simulator_choice: D11 gain assumed and sensitivity tested.

D12.status: separate process and device error requires repeated reference observations; assumed
D12.simulator_choice: D12 physiological process-error scale assumed; distinct from A10-A12 sensor measurement error.

fixed_generation_choices.D01_weather_proxy: (T_C - reference_mean_c) / reference_sd_c; local_heat = D01_weather_proxy_multiplier * environment_sensitivity * proxy + local_exposure_error
fixed_generation_choices.D07_bounded_latent_transform: clip(raw_latent, -D07_latent_clip_abs, D07_latent_clip_abs), before physical mapping; no full-dataset normalization
fixed_generation_choices.D13_target_transform: clip_0_10(intercept + gain * signed_dimensionless_construct + subject_reporting_bias + label_noise); fatigue and burden higher=worse, condition higher=better; weights remain protocol section 6.5
fixed_generation_choices.D14_clip_rule: clip to [0,10] once after reporting bias/noise; record pre-clip lower/upper rates; if predeclared tolerance exceeded, flag but never redraw or tune
fixed_generation_choices.D16_innovation_process: AR(1) in session index with coefficient phi and stationary marginal SD from A09; innovation_t = phi*innovation_previous + sqrt(1-phi^2)*epsilon, epsilon SD=A09
fixed_generation_choices.target_generation: Observed sensor values and past/current RPE labels never enter target equations; RPE serves only P06 empirical calibration and eventual evaluation target
fixed_generation_choices.device_claim: No physical station model, sensor part number, clinical error or military population distribution inferred
fixed_generation_choices.session_design: 60 activity sessions per subject sampled from P03/P04/P05; each yields one pre-activity observation and one post-activity observation in the same subject/session split. Fatigue and condition labels at both observations; exercise burden label only post-activity. The first 20 sessions provide past sensor/context history and are never target-evaluation sessions.
fixed_generation_choices.measurement_timing: Post-activity physiology is at nominal cessation; no delay inferred from PMData. It is a synthetic sampling convention, not a station measurement claim.
fixed_generation_choices.subject_distributions: P01 subject median empirical bootstrap; resting HR residual P02 empirical; temperature baseline Normal(P11_center,P11_subject_sd), bounded [35,38] C; SpO2 baseline Normal(P12_center,P12_subject_sd), bounded [95,100] percent; capacity median 1 lognormal log-SD A02; response/recovery/environment positive multipliers median 1 lognormal with A01/A04/A08 log-SD; recovery tau median A03 days times recovery multiplier.
fixed_generation_choices.unobserved_distributions: Activity error multiplicative max(0.1,1+Normal(0,A05)); task-demand multiplier lognormal median 1 and log-SD A06; local-exposure residual Normal(0,A07); acute cardiovascular, thermal and oxygen unobserved residuals independent Normal(0,A09/2); unobserved wellness follows D16 with marginal SD A09. Latent per-subject and per-session draws are independent unless explicitly linked by D16/recovery debt.
fixed_generation_choices.recovery_and_acute_states: Recovery debt = D07_clip(exp(-gap_days/tau_i)*previous_debt + D02*relative_dose + D03*max(0,local_heat) + wellness_innovation); cardiovascular strain = D07_clip(response_i*relative_dose + D04*debt + acute_cv_error); thermal strain = D07_clip(response_i*local_heat + D05*relative_dose + acute_thermal_error); oxygenation strain = D07_clip(D06*relative_dose + acute_oxygen_error). Pre-activity values exclude the current activity dose; post values include it.
fixed_generation_choices.physiology_and_sensor_distributions: True pre-HR=P01 baseline+P02 residual+D08*pre-debt+Normal(0,D12_pre_hr_process_sd); true post-HR=true pre-HR+D09*post cardiovascular strain+Normal(0,D12_post_hr_process_sd); true temperature=P11 baseline+D10*thermal strain+P11 within-person Normal residual+Normal(0,D12_temp_process_sd); true SpO2=P12 baseline-D11*oxygenation strain+P12 within-person Normal residual+Normal(0,D12_spo2_process_sd). Each sensor has a subject-specific Normal(0,A22*ordinary measurement SD) fixed bias plus independent Normal(0,A10/A11/A12) ordinary noise, and artifact Normal(0,A15*ordinary SD) with probability A14; ordinary missing A13, with artifact-missing dependence otherwise disabled. Physical values are clamped to HR [30,230], temperature [34,41] C, SpO2 [70,100] percent and clamp counts are reported; these bounds are simulator assumptions, not normal ranges or safety criteria.
fixed_generation_choices.quality_distribution: Binary diagnostic of the artifact event flipped independently with probability A16; if missing, quality absent. This is a deliberately simplified simulated SQI, not a device algorithm or measured sensitivity/specificity.
fixed_generation_choices.target_constructs: Fatigue shared=A19*(0.70*debt+0.30*CV); unshared=(1-A19)*wellness. Burden shared=A20*(0.50*relative_dose+0.30*CV+0.20*pre-debt); unshared=(1-A20)*log(task_demand)/max(A06,0.01). Condition shared=-A21*(0.40*debt+0.20*CV+0.25*thermal+0.15*oxygen); unshared=(1-A21)*wellness. Apply D13 target-specific intercept and common gain to sum of shared+unshared constructs, then subject reporting bias Normal(0,A17) and independent label noise Normal(0,A18). Model never observes these latent terms.

D03_local_heat_to_debt.unit: latent units per positive local heat

D04_debt_to_cv.unit: CV latent units per debt unit

D05_activity_to_thermal.unit: thermal latent units per relative dose

D06_activity_to_oxygen.unit: oxygenation latent units per relative dose

D13_burden_intercept.unit: 0-10 score units; BASE near P06 mean only

D13_score_gain.unit: score units per signed construct unit

D14_max_flagged_preclip_rate.unit: fraction; QC flag only, never generation acceptance criterion

A16_sqi_misclassification_probability.note: LOW=low SQI reliability; HIGH=high SQI reliability

real_world_device_or_population: chosen HR/temperature/SpO2 complete-device models and measurement sites
